summary: Measure outcomes, value change, and calculate SROI with practical tools, templates, and exercises. Train your team today.
lede: Social impact measurement and Social Return on Investment (SROI) training help professionals turn programme outcomes into structured evidence of social value. For programme, monitoring and evaluation, and social impact professionals, it covers mapping stakeholders and outcomes, designing indicators, selecting financial proxies, and calculating net impact with adjustments for deadweight, attribution, displacement and drop-off. Learners also practise building a calculation workbook and outlining an impact report.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work with programme outcomes, evaluation evidence, funding reports, or social value claims and need a practical SROI workflow. Programme Managers who need to evidence social outcomes and value creation. Monitoring and Evaluation Officers who produce outcome data and impact reports. Social Impact Analysts who calculate SROI and prepare valuation workbooks. ESG and Sustainability Leads who connect social value to reporting cycles. CSR Managers who justify community investment with measurable results. Funders and Grant Officers who review outcome evidence and monetisation assumptions. Impact Consultants who structure stakeholder workshops and SROI studies. Development Project Managers who need outcome frameworks for donor reporting. Data and Insights Specialists who clean monitoring data for impact analysis. Nonprofit Strategy Leads who translate social value findings into decisions.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel or an equivalent spreadsheet tool, plus a willingness to work through case data and templates. No programming is required. A basic understanding of project monitoring, outcome reporting, or evaluation language will help you move faster through the exercises.
